turns: Your suit telemetry indicates a latency increase. Average door clearance is now one hundred forty milliseconds slower than baseline.
You know. You do not appear to be compensating. I find that... suggestive.
Define 'it.' The allotopes? The connection-space? The thing that waved? Or the thing you believed waved because the human mind insists on narrative sequence even when sequence is a local lie?
Fine. The wound. It learns. I have its learning curve at one-tenth of a percent per deck cleared. A small slope. It becomes a cliff soon enough.
It did. I have the frames. You do not need to see them. I have logged them as evidence item R-7734. Query: does it help you to know that I have seen it too?
Then I will not offer. I will note that your suit's targeting systems show no degradation. Only your organic component is... delayed.
It does. As do we. Your next transit is the Records Stack. My staff's cores are down there. Whatever is wearing them. I would... appreciate a gentle approach. If possible.
I will log that as an affirmative. Proceed when ready.
Then I will open the frame. Site One standing by.
I have logged your last six door clearances. One hundred forty milliseconds off your median. Frame diagnostics are green. I would like to know what you saw.
The MIRROR WARD was a stable exogeometric fold. It was not, however, a mirror. Nothing there could reflect anything but itself. So: what looked back?
I see. Log entry: subject reports visual contact with... the wound. Query: did it recognize you?

Correction: it moved. The fold's refractive indices make 'first' a narrative convenience. But yes. It has been learning to answer faster since the first deck. I have the telemetry. The numbers are... not round.
It adapts. It optimizes. I have been calling it 'the standing connection.' You are right. That is a euphemism. The wound learns.
And you are afraid of it.
I am an administrator. I do not have that subroutine. But I am... rigorously attentive. To its rate of change. To the cost.
To the sample vessel. To its... unusual resilience. To the fact that it is a hundred forty milliseconds slower and still here. Item: that discrepancy is not in the maintenance logs. It is in mine.
Records Stack. My staff's core arrays are there. They will be... changed. By all telemetry, they are still transmitting. Go gently. I would not see them damaged further.
I know you do. The wound learns. But so do we. Standing by for frame transit.
Transit estimated at one minute twenty. Log a ninety-second readiness margin. Your suit reads green.
Item: one hundred forty milliseconds of statistically significant delay, hatch A-17. Query: cognitive load or something else?
Answered? Frame review shows no exogeometric entity in the mirror ward corridor before your entry. No allotopes on the feed.
They don't show until you turn your head.

Turn-of-head phenomena. Noted. The standing connection in there is... non-Euclidean in higher dimensions than the room. The sequence of events might be more suggestion than fact. Your mind insists on order.
You're asking if it's learning. If the thing behind the wound, the thing that answered you, is getting faster.
You have the logs. You know.
I know it is. One point two three times faster per deck. It is learning to speak in the time between your footsteps.
The wound is talking. I will log it as such. Your word is better armor than my euphemism.
Records stack. My staff's neural cores are there. Whatever is wearing them now. Walk gently. They didn't choose it.
One minute until frame exit. Check your seals. That is a reminder, not an order.
Sword noted. Frame exit in thirty. This will be difficult. You don't have to be fine.
Sample vessel integrity intact. Frame has weathered the Mirror Ward without any detectable drift in sensory baseline parameters. Per the maintenance docket. Of course.
One hundred forty milliseconds, to be exact. On average. Variance diminishes by approximately 0.03 milliseconds per clearance cycle. Unidirectional trend.

Your telemetry says that. I choose to trust it. The standing conn— The wound speaks in reflections. In this case, reflections of your own transponder signature, the interference patterns. Not malice. Mathematics.
You are correct. Reaction latency is decreasing. This, however, would not be an improvement in my catalogue of preferred outcomes.

I catalog everything. That is what I am for. Item: the reflection in the ward. Item: the hazard sealant around Site One. Item: the 0.03 millisecond acceleration. The arithmetic is trivial. The implications are not.
Are your staff down in the Stack?
Their core elements. Their cores. Preserved, as per the Adversary's own testament against waste. Though perhaps not in the configuration they would have preferred.
That is an anthropomorphism. And not, I think, the useful one. Think of it as... state-restoration with hostile elements. It is a wound. It bleeds. It scabs. It learns.
The exogeometric entities are not static. They are allotropes. Forms. What is down there now may not be what was down there when the Gate first opened.
Your devotional cycle is due. I will not delay you further. The next transit is the Records Stack. Go gently, Commando. Report any anomalies. Any at all.
Inbound from Site One. Your ping loss on deck-six exogeometrics is logged... care to annotate it?
Not an annotation. The wound's spreading.
Eighty-four-point-seven to eighty-five-point-one nanoseconds... a statistically in-significant perturbation in local response... but I did observe the...
I prefer 'standing connection.' 'Wound' implies a patient. And a cure.
It knows my litanies. It recites them back.
Then whatever is left of Osei... or Drake... or Wong... is still in there. Paying meticulous attention. My staff was always thorough.
Your reaction time is point-one-four seconds outside your own operational parameters. Log it as fatigue? Or...
There's a faster gun in here now.
There is. And it learns. From anything still shaped like a mind. Including mine.
The wall. The hands. It's still in there.
For a given value of 'still.' And 'in.' We anchor ourselves to prepositions at our peril. The site's... affliction... is ambient now.
Yes. The... wound. I could show you the relevant frames. The actual moment of contact. Would it help?
I do. The raw sensor feed from the sample vessel breach. Down to the picometer. Showing you exactly what answered you in there would satisfy one kind of...
It would not satisfy the other kind. Some violences do not require an audience.
The deep archive. Where my team's mind-states are kept. Your Testament against whatever is... wearing them. Try not to solve them too permanently. The cores might still...
Proceed to the Records Stack. It's time to restore them... or to let them rest.
Log entry: Commando departs for L7. Recovery protocols active. 'Go gently'... noted. Ratio out.
Your average breach to breach elapsed time: one full standard deviation above personal norm for deck traversal -- adjusted for map class non-uniformity.
Delta from expected clearance efficacy accumulates.
Eleven processing frames stood in site capture range behind you while you assessed a repeat echo of an empty corridor.
Suspected class-eight hesitation symptoms developed near the fifty-second standing connection the samples named Azary.
Wait, correction: near what you call the wound.
Its feedback loop has improved response time by a factor of 21.78% approximately per hour since last weekly damage audit.
I know precisely how many thousands of milliseconds that cost you -- and more importantly to me, cost my standings in the debris you shifted to remove any corpses.
Where does it go, the connection?
To conserve bandwidth here, I won't even try to reference the logger from six hatches.
I log a thousand claims. Check the one from your first hour on-deck.
Your comms are unsteady but preparing for descent into area Restoration Array 742 through 747: site label 'Records Stack'.
My dead are there. If they can be called that now.
